content.title: Maximum Subarray
content.description: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray which has the largest sum and return its sum.

examples.explanation: The subarray [4,-1,2,1] has the largest sum 6.
The subarray [1] has the largest sum 1.
The subarray [5,4,-1,7,8] has the largest sum 23.

hints: I will use Kadane's algorithm to keep track of the maximum sum ending at each position
Excellent choice! Kadane's algorithm works in O(n). Can you explain how you update the running sum and the global maximum?
Think about when to reset the running sum vs when to continue extending the subarray
follow_up_questions: Can you also return the actual subarray indices?
What if we needed the maximum product subarray instead?
How would you solve this with divide and conquer?
